$comment: Copy to scripts/config.json and fill in YOUR wallet addresses before running `npm run initialize`. All MHM amounts are in micro-MHM (1 MHM = 1000000).

initialMhmHolders.$comment: Wallets that receive an initial MHM allocation at launch (team / treasury / liquidity). Add one entry per holder wallet.

miningRateRangesMhmPerHour.$comment: Whole MHM per hour per rarity [min, max]. unique is the open-ended '20+' tier; the max is the roll cap. Tunable via update_config without redeploying.
